properties.description:
GS1/UNTP-aligned physical location types (the "where" of a product).

Merges UNTP Core Vocabulary facility types (production sites), storage
classifications (warehouses) and retail points-of-sale into one
discriminator. The location's role is given by ``location_type``.
properties.name: location_type

properties.description:
Whether one storage bin of this location may hold several products.

``mixed`` permits several products in a bin and is the default.
``single_product`` permits at most one product in an occupied bin. Once
emptied, the bin may hold another product; this is not a fixed reservation.
properties.name: bin_assignment_policy

properties.description:
Whether this location's balance may fall below zero.

``block`` refuses a withdrawal the balance cannot cover and is the default.
``allow`` lets it through and leaves the balance negative, which is how a
warehouse books a delivery it has already shipped before the goods receipt
was entered.

The location carries this, not the workspace: SAP sets it per valuation
area, plant and storage location, Dynamics 365 recommends letting exactly
one warehouse allow it while the items refuse it, and the Odoo community
module puts the same checkbox on the stock location. One switch for every
location would open the shops along with the warehouse.

Storage bins are deliberately out of reach of this policy. A bin holds a
placement or nothing at all (`ck_storage_bin_stock_quantity_positive`), so a
negative placement would have to exist as a row and contradict that.
properties.name: negative_stock_policy

week, or month by window length, every bucket present.

workspace creation; run history older than its retention is gone.

month by window length. Live passports are grouped by the production

mixes product, batch, and item subjects or infers historical readiness from
current state.

however many record passports it has. `items_without_passport` is today's
gap between the two. Independent of the dashboard range.

Writes one movement per target, all in one transaction: a source that cannot

operations.description:
Aggregate current stock positions and UTC ledger history for the home dashboard.

A position is a fungible product's on-hand balance at one location, read as
the stock tab reads it; archived products are left out. It is stocked when
that balance is not zero and below its reorder point when the location
states one and the balance is at or under it. The timeline counts ledger
movements per type; without `days` the window starts at workspace creation
and is bucketed per day, ISO week, or month by its length. Reorder alerts
are the five positions furthest under their reorder point.

How an operator closes a POS leg the worker could not finish.

`delivered`: the register already holds the change, only an unresolved
leg (`needs_reconciliation`) can be closed this way. `resend`: the change
did not arrive, so exactly this leg is queued again. Booking the movement a
second time instead would also repeat its other leg, and a Nulara-owned
source would be decremented twice.
properties.name: outcome

operations.description:
Close a POS leg the worker could not finish.

`delivered` records that the register already holds the change (only for a
leg whose outcome is unknown). `resend` queues exactly this leg again; the
movement is not booked a second time, so its other leg stays untouched.
